recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5282; future changes should be handled as ServiceRequest or workflow wording issues rather than DiagnosticOrder corrections.
issue_request: FHIR-5282 was a Published/Persuasive January 2015 OO ballot comment against the DiagnosticOrder resource page. It asked that "A request for a diagnostic investigation service to be performed" become "A record of a request for a diagnostic investigation service to be performed" and its resolution says to see FHIR-5279.
initial_application: The same historical source application used for FHIR-5279 also covers FHIR-5282. Commit d6259fa8e3 changed the DiagnosticOrder root long definition to the requested record-of-request wording and tagged [#5279], matching FHIR-5282's instruction to follow FHIR-5279.
additional_context: DiagnosticOrder and DiagnosticRequest are now removed current-build resources. Later Published issues FHIR-10295 and FHIR-11119 renamed DiagnosticOrder to DiagnosticRequest and then merged DiagnosticRequest with ProcedureRequest, while source/fhir.ini records DiagnosticOrder as subsumed into ServiceRequest. Current ServiceRequest source carries the broader record-of-request definition and [#5279][#11119] committee notes.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. FHIR-5282's requested DiagnosticOrder resource-page wording was applied historically, and the original target page is no longer part of the current build.
